sn9.8:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam aññataro bhikkhu Kosalesu viharati aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe || || Tena kho pana samayena so bhikkhu aññatarasmiṃ kule ativelam ajjhogāḷhappatto viharati || || Atha kho tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā tassa bhikkhuno anukampikā atthakāmā tam bhikkhuṃ saṃvejetu-kāmā yā tasmiṃ kule kulagharaṇī tassā vaṇṇam abhinimminitvā yena so bhikkhu ten-upasaṅkami || || Upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn9.8:2.1: Nadītīresu saṇṭhāne sabhāsu rathiyāsu ca || janā saṅgamma mantenti || mañ ca tañ ca kim antaranti || ||
sn9.8:3.1: Bahū hi saddā paccūhā || khamitabbā tapassinā || na tena maṅkuhotabbo || na hi tena kilissati || ||
sn9.8:4.1: yo ca saddaparittāsī || vane vātamigo yathā || lahucitto ti tam āhu || nāssa sampajjate vatan ti || ||
